question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
Revealing of crucial details of a film's plot.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Spoiler**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Spoiler"** refers to revealing crucial details or plot points of a story, movie, or series, which may ruin the experience for someone who hasn't watched it yet. (स्पॉइलर)
 
 
• **Example:** John gave away the spoiler by revealing the ending of the movie before anyone could watch it.
 
 
• **Explanation:** The term "Spoiler" is used to describe information that spoils or ruins the suspense or enjoyment of a film or story. (स्पॉइलर)
 
 
• **Example:** Avoid sharing spoilers when discussing the movie; not everyone has seen it yet!
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Spoiler**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Teaser** (टीज़र): A short preview or promotional material designed to arouse interest in a movie, series, or product without revealing too much.
 
 
• **Example:** The teaser for the new movie has everyone excited about its release.
 
 
 
• **Climax** (पराकाष्ठा): The most intense, exciting, or important part of a story or movie.
 
 
• **Example:** The climax of the movie had everyone on the edge of their seats.
 
 
 
• **Twister** (मोड़): A surprising or unexpected turn in the plot of a story or movie.
 
 
• **Example:** The plot twister at the end of the movie left everyone shocked.
